verdict.rationale: Khoj's documented Automations feature runs a user's query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency, which is a genuine recurring schedule rather than a one-off action. However, the recurring unit is a single chat query whose research result is emailed back. Nothing documents broader multi-step workflows or other job types. missing for 10: scheduling of multi-step workflows or arbitrary jobs beyond a single query, delivery targets other than email, documentation of schedule granularity and management (edit, pause, run history), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automations allow you run your query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency. Khoj will send its research to you as an email.
